name: Echo Forager
behavior: Crouch/glow → lunge last seen pos → 0.8s recover; dodge or jump.

name: Stonebound Guard
behavior: Raised arm, frontal guard; flank during 1.1s sweep recovery.

name: Rift Skitter
behavior: Marked crack, audible click, leap, retreat; no off-screen attack.

name: Prism Turret
behavior: Painted beam line locks before firing; cover, jump or flank.

name: Veraya Sentinel
behavior: Shield pulse then committed charge, vulnerable in recovery.

name: Mithril Keeper
behavior: Plating opens during cooldown; attack exposed core.

name: Echo Leech
behavior: Drifts toward exposed source; drain hazard telegraphed, interrupt with blade. Fewer after P06.

name: Fold Stalker
behavior: Spatial marker then attack from corresponding fold; evade before strike.
